Create Spectrogram Matrices for Trajectory Analysis

Source: R/trajectory.R
create_trajectory_matrix.Rd

Creates sliding-window spectrogram matrices from segmented motifs or bouts for trajectory analysis.

Usage

create_trajectory_matrix(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
create_trajectory_matrix(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lys'
create_trajectory_matrix(
  x,
  labels = NULL,
  window_size = 0.1,
  step_size = 0.005,
  wl = 128,
  ovlp = 50,
  fftw = TRUE,
  flim = c(1, 12),
  cores = NULL,
  balanced = FALSE,
  sample_percent = 100,
  max_samples_per_label = NULL,
  seed = 222,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A lys object or a data frame containing segment information.

...

Additional arguments passed to specific methods.

labels

Optional character vector of labels to include.

window_size

Numeric. Size of sliding window in seconds. Default 0.1.

step_size

Numeric. Step size between sliding windows in seconds. Default 0.005.

wl

Integer. Window length for spectrogram. Default 128.

ovlp

Numeric. Overlap percentage. Default 50.

fftw

Logical. Whether to use FFTW. Default TRUE.

flim

Numeric vector of length 2. Frequency limits in kHz. Default c(1, 12).

cores

Integer. Number of processing cores. If NULL, uses parallel::detectCores() - 1.

balanced

Logical. Whether to balance sample counts across groups. Default FALSE.

sample_percent

Numeric. Percentage of segments to sample (1–100). Default 100.

max_samples_per_label

Optional integer. Maximum samples per label. Default NULL.

seed

Integer. Random seed for sampling. Default 222.

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress. Default TRUE.

Value

For a lys object, the updated object with trajectory matrix and sliding window embeddings stored in lys$trajectory (returned invisibly).
